questions.question:
Find the missing number in the series:
14, 20, 34, 72, 182, ?
If MANGO is coded as NBNHP, then how is APPLE coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +1 in alphabetical order. A→B, P→Q, P→Q, L→M... wait, A+1=B, P+1=Q, P+1=Q, L+1=M... BQQLF is correct by +1 shift pattern.

questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, Riya says, 'He is the son of my grandfather's only son.' How is the person in the photograph related to Riya?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son = Riya's father. Son of father = Brother. So the person is Riya's brother.

questions.question:
Statements: All cats are dogs. No dog is a lion.
Conclusion I: No cat is a lion.
Conclusion II: Some dogs are cats.
questions.explanation: Since all cats are dogs and no dog is lion → no cat is lion (I follows). Since all cats are dogs → some dogs are cats (II follows). Both follow.

questions.question: Ramesh walks 10 km North, then turns Right and walks 5 km, then turns Right and walks 10 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He forms a U-shape. Net displacement = 5 km East from start.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Rose, Lotus, Marigold, Mango
questions.explanation: Rose, Lotus, Marigold are all flowers. Mango is a fruit — the odd one out.

questions.question: Which of the following is the mirror image of the word EDUCATION when mirror is placed on the right?
questions.explanation: Mirror image reverses left-right. EDUCATION → NOITACUDE when mirrored on the right side.

questions.question: A, B, C, D sit in a row. A is to the right of B. C is to the left of D. B is to the left of C. Who is sitting at the extreme right?
questions.explanation: Order from left: B, C, D and A is right of B. So: B–C–D with A... Arrangement: B–C–A–D? Let's work: B<C<D and B<A. If A is immediately right of B: B,A,C,D → A is rightmost? No. B<C, B<A means B–C–D and A right of B → A could be B,C,A,D → Rightmost is D? Actually solving: B<C<D and A right of B → B,C,D,A → A is extreme right.

questions.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: A Pen is used to Write. A Knife is used to Cut.

questions.question: Complete the series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letter goes A,B,C,D,E (forward). Second letter goes Z,Y,X,W,V (backward). Answer: EV.

questions.question: A father is 3 times as old as his son. After 10 years, he will be twice as old. What is the father's present age?
questions.explanation: Let son=x, father=3x. After 10 years: 3x+10=2(x+10) → 3x+10=2x+20 → x=10. Father=30.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Cricket, Football, Chess, Hockey
questions.explanation: Cricket, Football, Hockey are outdoor sports played with teams. Chess is an indoor board game.

questions.question: In a code: ROAD = 52, LOAD = 48. What is TOAD = ?
In a class of 40 students, Priya ranks 10th from the top. What is her rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = Total + 1 − Rank from top = 40 + 1 − 10 = 31st.

questions.question: Which Venn diagram correctly represents: Doctors, Humans, Engineers?
options: Doctors and Engineers inside Humans, no overlap with each other
questions.explanation: All Doctors and Engineers are Humans. But a person can't be both a Doctor and Engineer (generally). So both circles inside Humans, non-overlapping.

questions.question: A square paper is folded once (bottom to top) and a circular hole is punched in the center. When unfolded, how many holes appear?
questions.explanation: When folded once and punched, unfolding gives 2 holes — one on each half.

questions.question: A cube is painted Red on all 6 faces and then cut into 27 equal smaller cubes. How many small cubes have exactly 2 faces painted?
questions.explanation: Edge cubes (not corner) = 12. These have exactly 2 painted faces. Corner cubes=8 (3 faces), face cubes=6 (1 face), inner cube=1 (0 faces).

questions.question: Your colleague is stressed before an important presentation. What is the BEST response?
options: Tell them they look nervous which will make it worse
Offer a calm word of encouragement and ask if they need help
Report to the manager that they seem unprepared
questions.explanation: Emotional intelligence means recognizing others' feelings and responding with empathy. Offering calm support is the ideal response.
